summary:
Reviewed one commit, 9920c24, which the implementer's result also lists. It changes only migration-tools step definitions, to bind the feature lines e963f03 reworded before the claim. Nothing under features/ or scripts/ changed.
The 26 migration-tools tests pass. tools check: ruff has 15 issues, none on a new line; vulture is clean; there are no import contracts.
F1 (Important, observation): the r12 step that asserted a record's existing about is kept was deleted with its feature line, and the plan does not list it. The code (with_id) still keeps the about.
F2 (Minor, observation): the new 'has the content ... apart from' step accepts any id/kind/about lines, not just the ones r9/r12 give.
F3 and F4 (Minor, drop): the work-item's fileset is stale, and the ruff issues predate the commit.
The plan is stale (it accepts r1-r11, while the work-item accepts r1-r12), so the r12 bindings have no plan decision to check against.
